content.text: In today's landscape, digital creators in regions like Nigeria and Venezuela face significant barriers to launching online stores due to restrictions from platforms like Stripe and PayPal. COREMERCH offers a robust solution with its sovereign digital commerce infrastructure, allowing you to deploy a digital store for free on Cloudflare Pages. This guide walks you through the deployment process using Stack 02, ensuring that you can accept crypto [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-how-one-creator-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-9|USDT Payment]]-methods-filipino-digital-creators-step-step-deployment|payment]]s without intermediary platforms restricting your access.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The architecture of Stack 02 is built to withstand the challenges posed by conventional payment platforms. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments, you gain direct control over your digital store without dependency on a third party. This eliminates the risks associated with payment rejections and currency fluctuations. The infrastructure ensures that you retain ownership of your data and products, empowering you to focus on creating and selling without limitations.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To successfully launch your digital store, gather essential resources: a Cloudflare account, access to NOWPayments, and a framework for your product catalog. Ensure you have your digital products ready for upload, whether they are ebooks, templates, or courses. Familiarize yourself with GitHub for version control and understand the basics of Google Apps Script for backend logic. This preparation is crucial for a seamless deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The NOWPayments configuration sequence is the same regardless of which stack you are deploying. Create a NOWPayments account — no KYC required, no document upload, no bank account needed. Navigate to the wallet settings and add the wallet addresses for each cryptocurrency you want to accept. USDT on Tron and Bitcoin are the practical starting point for most creators in restricted markets. Generate an API key from the NOWPayments dashboard. Set the webhook endpoint URL in the NOWPayments IPN settings pointing to your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App. Set the webhook secret key — a string you generate that both NOWPayments and your backend know.
Gain full ownership of your digital store without platform dependency.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, it’s time to go live. Test your entire workflow from product selection to payment processing in a staging environment before launching. Ensure that your payment pipeline is functioning correctly by making a test transaction. Monitor the webhook events from NOWPayments to confirm that payments are verified on-chain. Once confirmed, your shop is operational, and you can start promoting your products.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your digital store live and operational, focus on scaling your offerings. Analyze customer feedback and sales data to identify high-demand products. Consider expanding your product range or offering subscription services for recurring revenue. Utilize marketing strategies that resonate with your audience to drive traffic to your store. Remember, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides additional resources to optimize and enhance your current infrastructure.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Deploy a fully functional online store in just 48 hours with Stack 02.

Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both platforms. While GitHub Pages offers a straightforward solution, Cloudflare Pages provides enhanced capabilities with Workers and better scalability for payment processing.

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular ones like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins. This flexibility allows you to cater to a wide audience of crypto users.
